note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this young-reader edition was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the 1962-register Old Testament renderings the first translation carried.

Consistent with the full edition (the-way-to-god, re-quoted in #9913): wherever both quote a verse they give the same OWB span — John 3:3 «አንድ ሰው ከላይ ካልተወለደ…», Luke 18:13 «እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ለእኔ ለኃጢአተኛው ራራልኝ!», Romans 5:6 «ገና አቅመ ቢሶች ሳለን», John 8:58, Exodus 20:3, Matthew 1:21, Philippians 3:10, Jeremiah 2:5/2:13/2:19 and Hosea 14:4 — and the same two phrases stay Moody's own words (1 Cor 15:10 'By the grace of God I will go no further'; 'the privilege of every child of God').

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, or the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause; chapter-head verses are given whole, with OWB's inner speech marks set as ‹ ›. Judgement calls: John 3:3 is OWB's «ከላይ ካልተወለደ» ('born from above'), so chapter 3 block 1 adds one bridging sentence tying it to the 'born again' (ዳግመኛ መወለድ) the chapter's prose keeps. Acts 3:19's 'times of refreshing' is OWB Acts 3:20; the chapter head keeps the English citation and runs on into 3:20's first clause («ይህም ከጌታ ፊት የእፎይታ ዘመናት እንዲመጡላችሁ»). Romans 6:23 'the gift of God' is OWB «እግዚአብሔር በነጻ የሚሰጠው ስጦታ» in chapter 5's prose too. Matthew 21:29's son now says OWB's «አልፈልግም» and the retelling recites OWB's «በኋላ ግን ሐሳቡን ለውጦ ሄደ». Jeremiah 2:19 keeps OWB's feminine address (እወቂ፤ እዪም).
